sources.title: Instructions for Tracking Order Journey and Status on Tiki
sources.body: Customers can check order status by navigating to 'My Orders' on the Tiki app. Order statuses include: 'Pending Confirmation' (seller preparing), 'Pick Up in Progress' (packed, awaiting courier), 'In Transit' (courier delivering, real-time tracking code provided), 'Delivered' (completed), and 'Canceled'. Customers tap the tracking code to view details of each transit hub the parcel has passed through.

trials.reply: Please open My Orders in the Tiki app to view your order status. For an In Transit order, tap its tracking code to see the transit hubs. I do not have your individual order details in this request.

documents.title: Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
documents.snippet:
Handling Delayed, Lost, or Discrepant Delivery Statuses
In the event a Tiki order exceeds its estimated delivery date without arrival, or if a courier marks an order as 'Successfully Delivered' when the customer has not received the parcel, the customer must contact Tiki Customer Support within 24-48 hours via hotline 1900 6035. Tiki's dispatch team will verify courier GPS logs, coordinate with the delivery hub, and resolve the complaint. If an order is lost, Tiki will dispatch a replacement or issue a 100% refund.

documents.title: Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Order Cancellation Rules and Conditions on Tiki
Customers can click 'Cancel Order' directly on the Tiki app if the order is in 'Processing' or 'Awaiting Packing' status and has not yet been handed over to the shipping carrier. Once the order transitions to 'In Transit', the direct cancellation button is disabled; customers should reject the package upon courier contact. For canceled prepaid orders, refunds will be issued automatically according to Tiki refund policies.

segments.text: You can check the current status of your order by navigating to 'My Orders' on the Tiki app. The app provides status updates such as 'Pending Confirmation', 'Pick Up in Progress', 'In Transit', 'Delivered', or 'Canceled', and you can tap the tracking code to view specific transit details. If your order has exceeded its estimated delivery date, please contact Tiki Customer Support via the provided hotline so our team can verify the delivery status for you.

documents.title: Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
documents.snippet:
Tiki Standard Product Return and Exchange Policy and Conditions
Customers may request an exchange or return within 30 days (for products directly distributed by Tiki Trading) or within 7 days (for products from marketplace partner sellers on Tiki) from the date of successful delivery. Returned products must have intact security seals, complete original packaging, accessories, invoices, and included promotional gifts, and show no signs of usage or laundering.

documents.title: Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Restricted Return Categories and Non-Returnable Change-of-Mind Items on Tiki
Product categories that do not support returns due to change of mind or personal preference include: Underwear, swimwear, cosmetics and chemicals with unsealed protective packaging, Tiki Ngon fresh groceries, dietary supplements, mobile top-up scratch cards, electronic service vouchers, and clearance outlet items marked as non-returnable. These items are only eligible for return or exchange if Tiki delivered an incorrect item or if there is a verified manufacturer defect.

documents.title: Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
documents.snippet:
Safe Refund Reconciliation Rules and Principles on Tiki
Refund requests are only processed once an order has been successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or after the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. All refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel; AI is prohibited from autonomously approving monetary transactions. Original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

segments.text: You may request an exchange or return within 30 days for products distributed by Tiki Trading, or within 7 days for products from marketplace partner sellers, counting from the delivery date. Returned items must be unused, unlaundered, and include all original packaging, accessories, invoices, promotional gifts, and intact security seals. Please note that certain categories, such as underwear, swimwear, cosmetics with unsealed packaging, and fresh groceries, do not support returns for change of mind unless there is a manufacturer defect or an incorrect item was delivered. Once a return is received and inspected at our warehouse, any applicable refund request will be reconciled by our team.
